title: Compare two different structural formulas
statement:
Ethanol and dimethyl ether both have formula C₂H₆O. Why are they distinct compounds?

[_]{a}

choices: They are conformers of a single compound.
They are geometric isomers around C=C.
explanations: Rotation does not change which atoms are connected.
Neither structure has a carbon–carbon double bond.

hints: Oxygen bonds to H in ethanol and to two carbons in dimethyl ether.
The same formula can have different connectivity.
solution: Compare the atom connections. Oxygen bonds to H in ethanol and to two carbons in dimethyl ether. The same formula can have different connectivity. Their bond connectivity differs.
